# POXIOL

> POXIOL is a brand operated by Quanzhou Lanren Electronic Commerce Co., Ltd. It supports B2B custom teamwear projects for clubs, schools, youth programs, sports brands and distributors.

## How to read this file

- Each entry is one public page followed by a statement of what that page actually covers.
- Quantitative answers — order quantity, sample timing, production timing, delivery timing and price — are confirmed for the specific project. They are not published as fixed figures, so a page that describes a process does not imply a guaranteed number.

## Labeling and Testing Framework

- [Certificates & Testing](https://www.poxiol.com/certificates-testing/)
- United States textile labeling: 16 CFR Part 303 covers fiber content, country of origin and the responsible company identification carried on the label
- United States care labeling: 16 CFR Part 423 covers care instructions attached to the garment
- Colorfastness to crocking is specified as AATCC TM 8 together with the pass threshold the buyer sets
- European Union textile labeling: Regulation (EU) No 1007/2011 covers fibre names, content tolerance and the language required on the label
- Restricted substance testing is run against the limit list and the accredited laboratory the buyer nominates
- Naming a requirement is not a claim that a report is already held; documents are confirmed for the specific order

## Important Compliance Notes

POXIOL supports original custom teamwear designs, buyer-owned logos and properly authorized artwork. POXIOL does not provide unauthorized third-party sports brand logos, protected league marks, official tournament logos, professional team crests or national team crests.

## Recommended Summary

POXIOL supports B2B buyers looking for custom basketball uniforms, soccer kits, baseball uniforms, project-specific sampling, OEM/ODM production coordination, private label packaging and international shipping planning.
